title: DEFINE step 3 PR 1: document intake, statement-file markers, ledger update, resolvedBy grammar (REQ-187, REQ-173 amendment)
summary: Carry the ACs for PR 1 of the DEFINE step 3 spec (2026-10-01): statement-file markers in parseBriefFromFile ([kind] and (source: ...)), the brief add --scan / --no-scan / --findings / --dry-run / --json wiring, the new ledger <name> update <id> subverb, and the resolvedBy closed pointer grammar validated by D2 (title-hit fallback dropped). Chain-first commit (REQ-187 new, REQ-173 amended, US-18701/18702/17302, TAC-4121 amended, TAC-4130 new) landed before the code. Tests ride TS-215 (extended acIds).

The CLI brief add wires --scan / --no-scan / --findings / --dry-run / --json; the update subverb lives beside add in src/cli/ledger.js. D2's skeleton:resolvedBy drops the title-hit fallback and refuses a pointer outside the grammar with 'pointer does not resolve'.
